feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote inference closely: the slides contained stitches, the actual poison vessel was present, and Elle had reached the waiting glass. It confirms transfer rather than introducing a new route or hidden forensic match. The continuing threat of exposure after repayment sharpens motive, although exposure was less explicitly developed than financial pressure beforehand; it is emotional explanation rather than necessary new proof. The image of being unable to touch her fabric gives the ending a personal consequence that suits her character. Claire and Hugh accept different forms of culpability without becoming alternative murderers, which feels useful and earned. The confession is somewhat explanatory, but it resolves the exact lie on which the accusation rested.
